speaker: james_burbage
text: The old play, at two. You are in the house. The doors are open.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I am in it. I am not giving the afternoon a new name on the way in.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Then do not. The yard is full enough to see from this step. I am not counting it for you.

speaker: john_heminges
text: And I am not naming a sum in a doorway. If the boxes are worth a sentence, I will spend it when I have the book open, not while the trumpet is up.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Keep the book for when you have it. I am going in with the others.

speaker: james_burbage
text: In, then. My doors know this play. They do not need a speech from the man who is about to be inside it.
